_readme: Facts that appear in more than one place — the homepage work cards and every résumé variant.
This file does not decide what is TRUE. It decides what every document has to AGREE on.
`canonical` is the value the site currently states; `conflicts` are values seen elsewhere
that contradict it. Run `npm run check:facts` after replacing any résumé PDF.
When you reconcile a fact, edit `canonical` here AND every document that states it.
A conflict is not always someone being wrong — 'Pre-IPO Biotech' vs 'ABVC BioPharma' is a
decision about whether the client is named, and it has to be the same decision in both places,
because the résumé is one click from the homepage.
